name: lead and opp status from opp to lead in job opening
script:
# RPO Job Opening Server Script
# Event: After Insert

# Server Script: Update Opportunity and Client Status when Job Opening is created
if doc.opportunity:   # agar opportunity linked hai
    # Update Opportunity Tracking status
    opp = frappe.get_doc("Opportunity Tracking", doc.opportunity)
    if opp.status == "Opportunity":
        opp.db_set("status", "Job Op Created")  # directly DB update karega
    
    # Update linked Client status
    if opp.client:   # agar client linked hai opportunity me
        client = frappe.get_doc("Client", opp.client)
        if client.status == "Opportunity":
            client.db_set("status", "Job Op Created")  # directly DB update karega

if doc.status == "Opportunity":
    # Check if opportunity already exists to avoid duplicates
    existing_opportunity = frappe.db.exists("Opportunity", {
        "opportunity_from": "Lead",
        "party_name": doc.name
    })
    
    if not existing_opportunity:
        try:
            # Create new opportunity with required fields
            opportunity = frappe.get_doc({
                "doctype": "Opportunity",
                "opportunity_from": "Lead",
                "party_name": doc.name,
                "customer_name": doc.lead_name or doc.company_name,
                "contact_person": doc.lead_name,
                "contact_email": doc.email_id,
                "contact_mobile": doc.mobile_no,
                "territory": doc.territory or "All Territories",
                "source": doc.source,
                "opportunity_owner":doc.lead_owner,
                "company": doc.company or frappe.defaults.get_user_default("Company")
            
            })
            
            # Insert the opportunity
            opportunity.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
            
            frappe.msgprint(f"Opportunity {opportunity.name} created successfully!")
            
        except Exception as e:
            frappe.log_error(f"Error creating opportunity from lead {doc.name}: {str(e)}")
            frappe.throw(f"Failed to create opportunity: {str(e)}")
